tools.description: List local tools with their exact server, name, description, and enabled state in Auto mode. Use before choosing or changing a tool; this does not change settings.
tools.name: get_tool_list

tools.description: Disable an unneeded Auto mode tool by its exact server and name from get_tool_list. Removes it from subsequent callable tools until reboot; manual settings remain unchanged. Tool Search controls are protected.
tools.name: set_tool_disabled

tools.description: Enable a disabled Auto mode tool by its exact server and name from get_tool_list. Updates shared selection until reboot; does not execute the tool or change manual settings.
tools.name: set_tool_enabled
